Sections.section_heading: MBBS in Georgia for Indian Students
Sections.section_body: Georgia, a country at the intersection of Europe and Asia, is a former Soviet republic that’s home to Caucasus Mountain villages and Black Sea beaches. Capital and largest city of Georgia is known as Tbilisi. Studying MBBS from Georgia has become one of the popular destinations for Indian students. A medical degree from Georgia is economical as medical universities have quite affordable fees. In addition, the MBBS degree from Georgia is recognized by National Medical Commission (NMC) and the World Health Organization (WHO). Getting admission in Georgian universities is quite easy and involves a very simple process. Tbilisi is considered to be the best place for studying MBBS in Georgia as it has achieved 100% of literacy. Living in Georgia is safe – Georgia is the 4th safest country in the world. Among the various countries, MBBS from Georgia is emerging as one of the top choices for Indian students. Georgia offers world-class medical education to students which surprisingly has low tuition fee of $4000 to $8000. However, Georgian universities offer customary education at simply reasonable course fees with no entrance test.

Sections.section_heading: Eligibility Criteria for MBBS in Russia

Sections.section_body: Medical Education: In terms of the percentage of the population in the world, Russia has the most college-level or higher graduates i.e. 54%. By the constitution Russia has a free educational system which is guaranteed for all the citizens but entry to subsidized higher education is highly competitive which results in a great emphasis on science and technology in education, and generally Russian medical, mathematical, scientific, and aerospace research is of a high order. MBBS from Russia is a preferred choice for International students because of the highly subsidized fee by the Russian Ministry of Health & Education as compared to other western countries. High Quality of Education combined with this low cost is one of the main reasons for choosing top medical universities of Russia for MBBS. There are almost 57 medical universities in Russia. The student to teacher ratio is 7:1 in all Russian Medical Universities. About 12 of these universities provide MBBS in English Medium. | MBBS in Russia Duration: Medicare and Medical benefits offered by the Russian government to the Indian citizens give MBBS students the opportunity to pursue high-class medical education in Russia. Russia, situated in the heart of Europe, is a very attractive destination not just for tourists but also for students who want to get higher education in science and technology. The Russian MBBS program lasts for 6 years including practical training. The duration of this course is equivalent to 10+2+3 courses that are given at schools and colleges in India. In this course of 6 years, a candidate will also study the Russian language for 6 semesters and physical training for 10 semesters. After completion of the first half of the medical curriculum and residency, students will be awarded with a degree in medicine equivalent to that of a Bachelor's Degree. At this time, students can proceed with an internship relevant to your respective field. | Accommodation: As an Indian student or parent, you are always concerned with the accommodation & dining facilities at the University. Living in Russia is quite affordable for the Indian students and never weighs big on your pocket. Their currency Rubles is similar to Indian Rupees. | Academic Session of MBBS courses in Russia: The duration of the prescribed courses at medical universities in Russia varies according to the pattern of studying. There are 3 types of universities according to which the courses vary from 6+ years to 7+ years. For English medium universities, the course duration of the MBBS course is 6+ years. This includes one year of internship. For bilingual or full-time Russian medium universities, the course duration of MBBS degree is 7+ years including one year of internship and one year for learning the Russian language. Russian medical universities usually start their academic session from September. The session for MBBS students generally starts from the 1st of October. (but it can also vary due to certain factors). | Language: Even though the medical education is in English in some universities, the majority of the population in Russia don't speak Russian. Hence you would have to learn the Russian language. | Weather: In general, the climate of Russia can be described as a highly continental influenced climate with warm to hot dry summers and (very) cold winters with temperatures of -30°C and lower and sometimes heavy snowfall. The winter is mostly dry, snow covers the ground from end October to mid march in some years.

Sections.section_heading: Eligibility Criteria for MBBS in Kazakhstan
Sections.section_body: Knowing the eligibility criteria for MBBS in Kazakhstan is highly beneficial for the applicants. Thorough knowledge of essential eligibility criteria for studying MBBS abroad help minimize the risk of application rejection. Here are the key eligibility criteria for MBBS in Kazakhstan an applicant must adhere to: Candidate must have passed their 10+2(sr. secondary education) Minimum 50% marks with PCB (physics, chemistry, and biology) from any recognized board NEET qualification mandatory The candidate must be minimum 17 Years old at 31st December of the year of admission.

Sections.section_heading: MBBS in Kyrgyzstan for Indian Students
Sections.section_body: Kyrgyzstan, officially the Kyrgyz Republic, also known as Kirghizia, is a landlocked country in Central Asia. It is bordered by Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and China. Its capital and largest city is Bishkek. MBBS from Kyrgyzstan is known for imparting high quality medical education. In Kyrgyzstan, MBBS degree is of 5 years of classroom training and 1 year of internship. The top medical universities in Kyrgyzstan offer medical education to over 5000 students every year. The medical colleges in Kyrgyzstan are recognized MCI, NMC, WHO, and the Ministry of Education, Kyrgyzstan. Kyrgyzstan comes under top 3 destinations in the world to study MBBS abroad due to its main advantage of studying MBBS at lower cost. International Licensing exams are permitted for students who have completed their medical degrees in Kyrgyzstan are permitted to apply for like PLAB (UK), USMLE (USA), MCI Screening Test, as well as other licensing exams taking place throughout the world. It’s called the Switzerland of Central Asia because of mountainous regions.

Sections.section_heading: MBBS in Uzbekistan for Indian Students
Sections.section_body: MBBS in Uzbekistan is economical also it offers a unique environment for MBBS study. MBBS from Uzbekistan is one of the qualifying results for Indian students to study medicine abroad. Most of the Uzbekistan medical universities are government-sponsored and thus are able to impart quality education and high-level training for medical studies. Most of the Indian students study medicine in Uzbekistan to become specialists, clinicians, and instructors. There are exchange programs available for Indian students to study in medical universities in Uzbekistan. There are seven medical institutes which are run by the Ministry of Health, Uzbekistan out of which 5 are approved by Medical Council of India. Indian students who graduate from these MCI recognized colleges are in demand across the globe. Uzbekistan, officially Republic of Uzbekistan, country in Central Asia. It lies mainly between two major rivers, the Syr Darya (ancient Jaxartes River) to the northeast and the Amu Darya (ancient Oxus River) to the southwest, though they only partly form its boundaries. Uzbekistan - bordered by Kazakhstan to the northwest and north, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan to the east and southeast, Afghanistan to the south, and Turkmenistan to the southwest.
